chunks: Then they were cast down upon their heads, [God said]: 'Truly, you know that these cannot speak.'
ai.seo_question: What do the idols say on the Day of Judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In this verse, the disbelievers are depicted bowing in humility, confessing that they knew their idols were merely silent objects incapable of speech or intercession. This moment of realization underscores the futility of associating partners with Allah, a core tenet in Shia theology, as the idols remain mute witnesses to their owners' deception on the Day of Judgment.
